_notes: READY-TO-EDIT optimizer config for MyClaude_V61 — Pass B (risk/exit sweep).
Run this AFTER Pass A: set Pass A's winning signal values MANUALLY in the study,
then sweep the risk/exit parameters below. Regenerate indices with CS6 first.
increment > 0  -> SWEPT.   increment == 0 -> IGNORED (set it MANUALLY in the study).
SET MANUALLY (the optimizer does NOT set these):
Pass A winner:
- Range Filter Period (idx 27), Range Filter Multiplier (idx 28),
RQK Lookback Window (idx 29)   <- the best values you found in Pass A
Enablement / safety interlock:
- Enable Order Submission (idx 35) = Yes
- ALLOW LIVE (idx 36)             = No
- FLATTEN NOW (idx 39)            = No
- Trade >> Trade Simulation Mode  = ON
REQUIRED for this sweep to actually do anything:
- Stop Type (idx 0) = 0 (ATR)   <- else 'Stop ATR x' (idx 1) has NO effect
- Trailing Stop after TP1 (idx 7) = Yes <- else 'Trail ATR x' (idx 8) has NO effect
- TP1 Close % (idx 5) < 100 (default 50) <- else there is no TP2 runner to size
Other held inputs: Order Quantity (idx 18)=1, Trend MA (idx 40)=200,
Long Only (idx 41)=Yes, session/block times aligned to instrument timezone.
REPLAY MODE: keep replayMode = 1 (Standard). Mode 2 can yield ZERO trades because
the study early-returns on sc.IsFullRecalculation. Verify fills on the first combo.
WARM-UP: set startDate a few hundred bars before your evaluation window.
Pass B below = 4 x 3 x 4 x 3 = 144 combinations.
